description: BeatWave 5.1.3 — fixes the search bar and results navigation, adds library playlist multi-thumbnails, introduces Google Cast integration, improves font contrast adaptation, and enhances Wrapped intervals and performance.

changelog.title: Search & Navigation (Fixed)
items: Fixed search navigation: submitting a search query or tapping on search suggestions now properly dismisses the search panel and displays the search results screen.
Search bar keyboard handling streamlined for smooth transitions between suggestions and live search results.
Direct YouTube URL parsing and search query support directly from the search bar.

changelog.title: Library & UI Enhancements
items: Dynamic multi-artwork collage thumbnails for local and imported playlists in Library.
Adaptive font contrast improvements across liquid glass and tinted backgrounds.
Dark search interface refinements and enhanced color consistency with home themes.
Adjusted Admin Panel and bottom sheet insets for edge-to-edge screens.

changelog.title: Cast & Wrapped
items: Google Cast device discovery and seamless media streaming support via Cast button.
BeatWave Wrapped: added customizable time window intervals (3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 365 days) with test suite.
Automated What's New changelog dialog prompt on app launch after updates.

changelog.title: Audio & Performance
items: Smoother liquid glass shader performance and reduced background re-draw overhead.
Color palette matching between Moods & Genres categories and Home feed.
Memory optimization and improved audio queue reliability.
